theme.zh: 游戏道具制作与团队共享

followup.en:
The question is whether Team Plan saves your team work after edits, review and handoffs are counted, not just whether it generates a model quickly.

A proposed pilot would compare 10 real props or characters from your project with your current process:
• Asset work: time to the first useful model, generation and retry costs, artist cleanup, review, and work needed to move the asset into your tools. Failed attempts count too.
• Project fit: your team's acceptance checklist, including topology, polygon count, UVs, materials, formats, rigging where needed, and checks in the game engine.
• Teamwork: whether colleagues can find and reuse the result, how many handoffs are needed, and time spent managing credits and permissions.

That comparison gives you the total time and cost per approved asset, rather than generation cost alone. Your team keeps the final approval decision.

Before starting, the proposal needs agreement with Tripo on the checklist, who runs each check, and which generation and review records can be provided. Those records should fit your team's disclosure and audit process. Work refined outside Tripo stays in your team's existing production workflow.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. Availability, scope, access, fees and responsibilities need to be agreed first.
followup.zh:
关键不是生成一个模型有多快，而是把修改、审核和交接都算进去后，Team Plan 能不能让团队少花一些工夫。

建议用项目里的 10 个真实道具或角色，与现有流程做一次对照，具体包括：
• 资产制作：首个可用模型所需的时间、生成和重试费用、美术清理修改、审核，以及把资产接入现有工具的工作。失败的尝试也算进去。
• 项目适配：按您团队的验收清单，检查拓扑、面数、UV、材质、格式、需要时的绑定，以及游戏引擎内的结果。
• 团队协作：其他成员能否找到并复用成果、需要几次交接，以及积分和权限管理花了多少时间。

这样比较的是每个通过验收的资产所需的总工时和总成本，不只是生成费用。最终是否采用，仍由您的团队决定。

开始前，需与 Tripo 确认验收清单、每项检查由谁执行，以及可以提供哪些生成和审核记录，以衔接您团队的披露与审计流程。在 Tripo 外精修的文件，仍在团队现有制作流程中管理。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。是否可安排、具体范围、使用权限、费用和双方分工，均需在开始前确认。

subject.en: Less modeling from scratch for your next game update
subject.zh: 下一版游戏，让团队少从零建模

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

For the next game update, could your artists start some props from generated models? That gives them a starting point to refine, instead of building every shape by hand.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your art team one workspace to:
• Generate starting 3D models from text or reference images, then continue in their usual tools.
• Find and reuse shared models instead of repeating the same modeling or requesting files again.
• Share a credit pool, with member access and usage managed in one place.

Your artists still refine the models and decide what meets the game's requirements.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. See whether generation and reuse reduce the total work behind an approved asset, including edits and review.

followup.en:
The proposed test would compare 10 real assets from your project with your current process. It is a way to assess the work needed for approved assets, not just generation speed.

Before starting, your team and Tripo would agree the acceptance checklist, who runs the tests and who records the results, including any testing support Tripo can provide. Your team keeps final approval.

Your engineers would connect the API to your asset tool: submit text or images, check asynchronous task status and retrieve completed models. Tripo provides generation through the API; your team builds and maintains the integration. Artists then refine the outputs.

The comparison would cover:
• Time to the first useful model and the first approved asset.
• Generation and retry charges, artist cleanup, review, integration and ongoing maintenance. Failed attempts and rework count too.
• Project checks such as topology, polygon count, UVs, materials, rigging where needed, file formats and the result in your target engine.

Generation and review records would feed into your team's disclosure and audit process, with record-keeping responsibilities agreed before testing.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. Scope, access and fees will be agreed before it starts.
followup.zh:
计划用项目里的 10 个真实资产，与团队当前的制作流程做一次对比。看的是模型通过验收所需的完整投入，而不只是生成速度。

开始前，您的团队与 Tripo 先确认验收清单、谁执行测试、谁记录结果，以及 Tripo 能提供哪些评测支持。最终验收权仍在您的团队。

工程团队把 API 接入资产工具：提交文字或图片、查询异步任务状态，在任务完成后取回模型。Tripo 通过 API 提供生成能力，您的团队负责接入和维护集成，美术再继续修改输出。

对比内容包括：
• 拿到首个可用模型，以及首个通过验收的资产，各需多久。
• 生成与重试费用、美术清理和审核工时、接入及后续维护。失败尝试和返工也计入。
• 按项目需要检查拓扑、面数、UV、材质、必要的绑定、文件格式，以及目标引擎中的表现。

生成和审核记录纳入团队自己的披露与审计流程，具体由谁记录、保留什么，在测试前约定。

theme.en: 3D product content for your pages and platform
theme.zh: 为产品页面和内容平台制作 3D 展示

followup.en:
The proposed test would compare 10 real product assets with your current process, through to models approved for your pages. A generated shape is not yet an accurate product display.

Before starting, your team and Tripo would agree the product-accuracy checks, who runs the tests and who records the results, including any testing support Tripo can provide. Your team keeps final approval.

Your engineers would submit product images through the API, check asynchronous task status and retrieve completed models. The API returns model files. Your team connects its chosen viewer, corrects the models against the real products and controls publication.

The comparison would cover:
• Time to the first useful model and the first model approved for display.
• Generation and retry charges, manual correction and review, integration and ongoing maintenance. Failed attempts and rework count too.
• Product shape, proportions and appearance, plus topology, polygon count, UVs, file formats and performance in the page viewer where relevant.

Generation and review records would feed into your team's disclosure and audit process, with record-keeping responsibilities agreed before testing.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. Scope, access and fees will be agreed before it starts.
followup.zh:
计划用 10 个真实产品资产，与团队当前流程做对比，一直看到模型能否通过页面展示要求的验收。生成出一个形状，不等于已准确还原产品。

开始前，您的团队与 Tripo 先确认产品还原的检查项、谁执行测试、谁记录结果，以及 Tripo 能提供哪些评测支持。最终验收权仍在您的团队。

工程团队通过 API 提交产品图片、查询异步任务状态，在任务完成后取回模型。API 返回模型文件，页面查看器由您的团队选择并接入。内容团队对照实物修正模型，并决定是否发布。

对比内容包括：
• 拿到首个可用模型，以及首个通过展示验收的模型，各需多久。
• 生成与重试费用、人工修正和审核工时、接入及后续维护。失败尝试和返工也计入。
• 产品的形状、比例和外观，并按用途检查拓扑、面数、UV、文件格式，以及页面查看器中的表现。

生成和审核记录纳入团队自己的披露与审计流程，具体由谁记录、保留什么，在测试前约定。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。开始前会确认范围、使用权限和费用。
